During the riots I didn’t find time to visit Shanice and Priestbot.
Although I’m kind of worried about Shanice since she’s such an airhead, I’m sure that Priestbot would take care of any troubles.
Nevertheless, I should’ve visited them even if just as a courtesy. That’s what friends do for eachother, right?
What happened, happened and all I can do now is just go there with no further delays.
